entries.name: T1.8 Markov-2 alpha sensitivity sweep
entries.decision_rule: Run the Markov-2 null at alpha in {0, 0.5, 1, 5} on USoc and BHPS at L=5000 under frozen PCA loadings. If the rejection direction of the Markov-2 W2 test is the same (reject or fail-to-reject) at every alpha for a given dataset, the conclusion is stable and alpha=1 is locked as the canonical smoothing constant via a [DECISION]. If the rejection direction changes across alpha, the alpha-sensitivity is reported as a caveat and alpha=1 is NOT promoted as immaterial.

prose_direction.stable_across_alpha: Report Markov-2 conclusion as robust to smoothing; cite alpha=1 as canonical with a one-line sensitivity footnote.
prose_direction.unstable_across_alpha: Report the alpha-dependence explicitly; do not claim smoothing is immaterial.

entries.name: T1.10 Mapper threshold sensitivity sweep
entries.decision_rule: Descriptive sensitivity: recompute the Mapper sub-regime node count at |z| in {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}, report B, and BH-correct per-node z-scores. High-confidence sub-regime nodes are those flagged BH-significant at all three thresholds. No prose-direction lock; the result is reported as a robustness sweep.

entries.name: T1.11 KDE sub-level-set H0
entries.decision_rule: Compute KDE sub-level-set H0 on the PCA-20D embedding (frozen loadings), tree-cut at prominence consistent with k=7, and compute ARI against the GMM regimes. ARI > 0.3 indicates substantial recovery of the density-mode regime structure by the correct (density-based) topological summary; ARI <= 0.3 indicates the KDE H0 partition does not substantially recover the GMM regimes.

prose_direction.ari_gt_0_3: Report the KDE sub-level-set H0 as the correct topological evidence for density-mode regimes (positive complement to the VR H0 connectivity caveat).
prose_direction.ari_le_0_3: Report that the density-mode topological summary only partially recovers the GMM regimes; temper the positive-complement framing accordingly.
